_comment: 无人值守内容流水线的目标关键词库。gen_article.py 每次取 keywords 里第一个未发布的词；写完一轮后在 'later' 里补充新词。angle 是给 LLM 的写作角度提示。

keywords.angle: Explain how OCR makes scanned PDFs convertible, walk through the exact workflow on our converter, cover common failure cases (skewed scans, handwriting, multi-column layouts) and how to verify OCR output quality.

keywords.keyword: pdf to markdown converter online free
keywords.angle: Honest overview of what a free online converter should offer (page limits, privacy, table preservation), comparison criteria checklist, and where our free 200 pages/month tier fits. Avoid bashing competitors by name.

Deep dive on extracting tables from PDFs into GFM pipe tables: why tables break in naive conversion, field tables vs comparison tables vs return-code tables, and how to fix misaligned columns manually.

Workflow for getting PDF content into Obsidian vaults: headings map to headings, tables stay as pipe tables, frontmatter suggestions, folder organization by chapter, linking notes. Obsidian users are a core audience.

keywords.keyword: extract pdf headings to markdown outline
keywords.angle: How PDF bookmarks/TOC become Markdown headings, how to build a clean document outline from a 100+ page manual, and why heading hierarchy matters for downstream tools.

Explain why pandoc cannot read PDF input directly (PDF is an output format), what workarounds exist (pdftotext + cleanup, python pipelines), and when a dedicated online converter is the faster path. Fair and technical.

keywords.keyword: convert pdf to markdown with python
keywords.angle: Developer-oriented: overview of pypdf/PyMuPDF text extraction, OCR fallback with RapidOCR, table detection challenges, then present our hosted converter as the no-maintenance option for teams. Include small honest code snippets.

keywords.keyword: pdf to markdown for RAG pipelines
keywords.angle: Why Markdown is the best chunking input for RAG (headings as semantic boundaries, tables preserved), how to preprocess PDFs for LLM knowledge bases, chunking strategy by heading levels.

keywords.keyword: batch convert multiple pdfs to markdown
keywords.angle: Strategies for converting document sets: naming conventions, queueing with our task system, monthly page quotas and planning, organizing outputs into folders.

keywords.keyword: ocr best practices for old scanned documents
keywords.angle: Practical preprocessing tips: scan resolution, deskewing, language settings, handling stamps and margin notes, when manual review is needed. Complements the existing OCR best practices post with interlink.
For researchers/students: converting lecture notes and papers for note-taking, citation handling caveats, equations limitations honesty, keeping tables for literature reviews.

keywords.keyword: pdf user manual to markdown documentation
keywords.angle: For technical writers: turning PDF manuals into maintainable docs, bookmark-based chapter structure, code blocks preserved, publishing to docs sites like MkDocs/Docusaurus.
What image-only PDFs are, how to detect them, why copy-paste fails, and OCR-based extraction workflow end to end.

keywords.keyword: markdown folder structure from pdf bookmarks
keywords.angle: Splitting long PDFs into per-chapter Markdown files using bookmark levels, naming conventions, and assembling a mini knowledge base.

later.angle: German-language article (write the article in German). Same quality bar; German market has weak competition.
Spanish-language article (write the article in Spanish).
Comparison article. Research actual current pricing/features first; be fair, focus on general document conversion vs math-focused tools.
Notion import workflow: what Notion accepts, how to prepare Markdown files, limitations of Notion's importer.
